security_spec.violation_condition: Linux IOPMP driver compiled against pre-v2.1 spec headers reads HWCFG2 using old bit positions (chk_x@24→now rsv, peis@26→now 27, pees@27→now 28, prient_prog@25→now prio_ent_prog@16), causing silent capability misdetection and incorrect entry configuration (e.g., instruction-fetch check assumed disabled when hardware supports it, leaving x=0 entries unprotected)
security_spec.summary: HWCFG2 bit layout redefined (chk_x 24→26, peis 26→27, pees 27→28, prio_ent_prog 25→16, new non_prio_en@17, user_cfg_en removed); kernel drivers using stale bit offsets will misread IOPMP capabilities, potentially disabling instruction-fetch and non-priority-entry enforcement for DMA agents
